_comment: Kalshi series to watch. Series tickers are the prefix before the first dash in a market ticker. Find them at kalshi.com or via /series endpoint.
_pinned_comment: Specific market tickers to always watch regardless of volume.

thresholds._comment: min_volume_24h: ignore markets thinner than this unless pinned. move_cents: alert when the YES mid moves this many cents since the last poll. vol_spike_x: alert when 24h volume multiplies by this factor.
